accounting_scope: Non-atomic scoped regular-file stat samples. Apparent bytes sum st_size. Allocated bytes sum st_blocks * 512. Component names use the first child beneath a role or its bucket namespace. No directories, ballast, cgroup, filesystem metadata, unlinked files or physical-media durability accounting.
